patterns.note: Sections alternate between full-width immersive imagery and content blocks with generous padding, often featuring asymmetrical text and image arrangements.
A sophisticated serif font is used for all major headings, often with a subtle underline for emphasis, creating an elegant and editorial feel.
A consistent palette of deep forest greens, muted olive greens, and warm off-whites dominates, evoking a natural and refined aesthetic.

The primary navigation bar transforms upon scroll, shrinking in height and changing from a transparent background with dark text to a solid dark green background with light text and a distinct button style.
Illustrative line-art drawings are used to represent different home types or concepts, adding a unique, handcrafted touch to feature sections.

technique_notes: The hero section utilizes a video background to create an immersive, dynamic introduction. Content is overlaid with a subtle gradient or dark tint for text legibility.

Scroll-triggered motion is applied to the header, where its background color, text color, and button styling animate smoothly as the user scrolls past the initial hero content, creating a sticky, transforming navigation bar.
Image sections often employ the 'object-fit: cover' technique to ensure images fill their containers while maintaining aspect ratio, creating a full-bleed or near full-bleed visual impact.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, elegant serif headings (~3-4x body) with a classic character, paired with clean, readable sans-serif body text and uppercase navigation labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding on buttons and interactive elements, otherwise sharp corners for content blocks and section boundaries.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy and open, particularly in hero and between major sections, creating a sense of calm and luxury; content within sections is balanced.

standout: The site's distinctive blend of elegant serif typography, a rich, earthy green color palette, and sophisticated line-art illustrations creates a unique 'refined rustic' aesthetic. It feels both luxurious and deeply connected to nature, avoiding typical modern minimalism for a more editorial and timeless appeal.
